summary: Frontend-only UI validation for the Duplicates/Trash/Jobs-lifecycle cycle on the production preview. All requested flows work: 6 clickable KPI cards navigate to correctly filtered lists, expiring-jobs alert renders with clickable job links, Vacantes toggle-archived-jobs alternates active/archived views, archive→reactivate cycle preserves state (Analista de Pruebas archived then reactivated, left active as originally), Duplicates 'Posibles duplicados' shows per-candidate delete buttons and 'Eliminar grupo (sobrantes)' with browser-native confirm dialogs (cancelled to avoid touching real data), 'CV idénticos' tab loads without errors, Papelera lists 200 deleted candidates and search filters correctly, restore of synthetic ZZTest candidate worked (toast 'ZZTest Papelera UI restaurada' + item removed). Similar-archived dialog on job creation was not exercised because there are currently 0 archived jobs in the DB and the task explicitly asks to avoid creating test vacantes; feature is wired in code (JobsPage.js:222 similar-archived-dialog + reuse-candidate-{id} + reuse-candidates-confirm).
critical_code_review_comments: Delete confirmations rely on window.confirm (browser-native). Works but is inconsistent with the rest of the app that uses shadcn AlertDialog. Consider migrating for a11y/UX consistency.

TrashPage shows '200 fichas eliminadas' as a hard-coded looking header (actual: 199 after restore). Confirm the count reflects filtered vs total; currently the header updates correctly but pagination beyond 200 items is not evident (page size limit worth checking if the trash grows).
Similar-archived-dialog flow could not be exercised e2e because there are 0 archived jobs; consider a lightweight backend fixture/toggle for QA to seed archived jobs without touching production.
seed_data_creation: Inserted synthetic candidate id='zz-trash-ui' (is_deleted=true) to exercise Papelera restore flow. Restored via UI, then deleted from DB at end of test. DB state left identical to start.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 6 dashboard KPI cards, jobs-expiring-alert, toggle-archived-jobs, archive-job-{id}, reactivate-job-{id}, delete-candidate-{id}, delete-group-extras-btn, tab-identical-cv, trash-search, trash-restore-{id} verified against the production preview. The archive/reactivate round-trip was performed on job 'Analista de Pruebas' (id 8e9f4dbf-1b6f-4ab9-960c-4fdcbbb43023) and returned to active state. Similar-archived dialog was NOT exercised (0 archived jobs available; skipped per instruction to avoid creating test vacantes).
